"""逐题独立小域锚点的错误变异检查。"""
import importlib.util,inspect,json
from pathlib import Path
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('o','/tmp/gmyhf_batch7_oracles.py');m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
changes=[(18159, 'prime_tail', 'range(11,n,10)', 'range(11,n,20)', '漏掉个位为1的质数'), (27150, 'divisible_eight', 'digit%8', 'digit%7', '单字符除数错误'), (28190, 'cows', 'j-i+1', 'j-i', '牛群长度少算端点'), (28203, 'next_greater', 'a[j]<=a[i]', 'a[j]<a[i]', '把相等元素当作更大'), (30179, 'puzzle', 'parity==distance%2', 'parity!=distance%2', '可解奇偶条件取反'), (30550, 'pythagorean', 'range(1,n//c+1)', 'range(1,n//c)', '漏掉最大合法倍数'), (30720, 'loser_tree', 'losers[u]=max', 'losers[u]=min', '把胜者写成败者'), (30908, 'online_force', 'last=mid.maximum', 'last=-mid.maximum', '区间最大值符号错误'), (30921, 'blocks', 'total>=threshold', 'total>threshold', '恰好达到阈值时不坍塌'), (30937, 'zero_one_mst', 'str(components-1)', 'str(components)', '最小生成树权重偏一'), (31454, 'first_repeat', 'run>=gap', 'run>gap', '拒绝恰好相邻重复块')]
rows=[]
for n,name,old,new,reason in changes:
 original=getattr(m,name);src=inspect.getsource(original);assert old in src,(n,old);exec(compile(src.replace(old,new),'<mutation>','exec'),m.__dict__);m.SOLVERS[n]=getattr(m,name)
 try:m.selfcheck()
 except (AssertionError,ValueError,IndexError,KeyError,ArithmeticError):killed=True
 else:killed=False
 setattr(m,name,original);m.SOLVERS[n]=original
 assert killed,(n,name);rows.append({'global_number':n,'function':name,'defect':reason,'replace_before':old,'replace_after':new,'killed':True});print(n,'变异检出',flush=True)
Path('/tmp/gmyhf-batch7-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')

"""删除失效父链压缩后，自造链式遍历计数必须检出平方退化。"""

from pathlib import Path
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('o','/tmp/gmyhf_batch7_oracles.py');m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(m);source=inspect.getsource(m.blocks);old='   for w in path:parent[w]=u\n';assert old in source;changed=source.replace(old,'',1)
try:m.blocks_complexity_check(changed)
except AssertionError:pass
else:raise AssertionError('删除失效路径压缩未检出')
Path('/tmp/gmyhf-batch7-path-mutation.json').write_text(json.dumps([{'global_number':30921,'function':'blocks.find','defect':'删除失效路径压缩导致链式重复遍历退化','replace_before':old,'replace_after':'','killed':True}],ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print('失效父链复杂度变异检出')
